transcription: Manually transcribed by Codex from balance-redacted source-resolution pixels on 2026-11-02, independently of recognition output and other agents; human verification is required before golden metrics.

source.provided: Fifteen original JPEG files from the LIVE screenshots directory, supplied for public corpus inclusion; originals remain outside the repository.
source.redaction: Each original JPEG was decoded once to RGB with zune-jpeg 0.5.15, filled with black over CURRENT BALANCE at x=2896,y=272,width=352,height=128, and stored as lossless RGB PNG with png 0.18.1. PNG readback matched the masked raster byte for byte; every pixel outside the rectangle matched the decoded original. JPEG block-lossless redaction was unavailable in this intake route. The conservative allowed reencoded-unknown fidelity class makes no resolution or capture-method coverage claim.
source.captureTimeNote: Confirmed by the project owner on 2026-11-02: conditions.originalFile retains the unchanged game-generated local filename, in MEZ (UTC+01:00), with no clock change. capturedAt converts its date/time to UTC at second precision; the opaque hexadecimal suffix is not interpreted as milliseconds.
